arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count
FROM main.cards AS c
WHERE c.isPromo = 1
  AND instr(',' || c.types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
  AND instr(c.leadershipSkills, '''brawl'': True') > 0
LIMIT 1
